meta.name: design-taste-frontend
meta.description: Anti-slop frontend skill for landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns. The agent reads the brief, infers the right design direction, and ships interfaces that do not look templated. Real design systems when applicable, audit-first on redesigns, strict pre-flight check.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为落地页和作品集生成不套模板的前端界面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果厌倦了模板化设计，想要有品味的定制前端界面。
copy.tagline_en: Ship non-templated frontend interfaces for landing pages and portfolios.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are tired of templated designs and want tasteful custom frontend interfaces.

howto.what: 当你让它做落地页、作品集或改版时,Claude 先给出一行设计解读(页面类型+受众+风格),再设变化度、动效强度、视觉密度三个参数,然后写前端代码,合适时会装官方设计系统包。
howto.when: 当你要求做落地页、作品集页面或改版设计时触发;仪表盘、数据表格、多步产品 UI 不在它的范围内。

say.text: 做一个极简风的 SaaS 落地页,先说出你的设计解读
say.note: 它会先声明解读,再动手写代码

say.text: 把这个现有站点改版,保留原品牌配色和字体
say.note: 改版走先审查再改的流程

say.text: 用 Tailwind v4 和 Phosphor 图标重做这个作品集页
say.note: 按默认技术栈和图标库生成

howto.what_en: For landing pages, portfolios, or redesigns, Claude first states a one-line Design Read (page kind, audience, vibe), sets three dials (variation, motion, density), then writes the frontend code, using official design-system packages when apt.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a landing page, portfolio, or redesign. Dashboards, data tables, and multi-step product UI are out of scope.

say_en.text: Build a minimalist SaaS landing page — state your Design Read first.
say_en.note: It declares the read before coding

say_en.text: Redesign this existing site, keeping its brand colors and type.
Rebuild this portfolio page with Tailwind v4 and Phosphor icons.
say_en.note: Uses the default stack and icon set
